name: Prefect
description: Connect Prefect Cloud to inspect workflows, diagnose failed, late, or stuck runs, review workspace and worker health, and search current Prefect documentation and release notes. The hosted tools are read-only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Prefect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Prefect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://prefect.fastmcp.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Prefect MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prefect lists 15 MCP tools, including docs_get_release_notes, docs_search_prefect, get_automations, get_dashboard, get_deployments, get_flow_run_logs, get_flow_runs, get_flows, get_identity, get_object_schema, get_task_runs, and get_work_pools.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Prefect?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Prefect in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Prefect requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Prefect is developed by Prefect Technologies. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
